title: When the Gravity Breaks Anew
author: Mirabel Vane
blurb: Edmund Marchetti, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
